description: Fetch one ticket by id, including comments and attribution (customer vs service_account). Use when you already have a ticket_id like TCK-1001. If you do not have an id, call search_tickets first — a missing id is not a reason to invent one. Same data is also at ticket://TCK-1001.

ticket_id.description: Existing ticket id from search_tickets. Format: TCK-1001. Do not invent an id.

name: get_ticket
